aspect: The evidence is unavailable by design
description: Undue influence is contested after the only witness to it has died, which is why it succeeds.
energy_note: Disputed after the one witness is gone.

aspect: Capacity and pressure are different questions
description: She may have capacity and still be under pressure, and the legal test frequently examines only the first.
energy_note: Capable of signing, and not free to refuse.

description: He arranges it, drives her, sits in the waiting room, and has already told the solicitor she gets confused about money. She signs. He is not in the room, which is the point.
energy_note: He waits outside, having spoken first.
